# create-boost-app

> Official BoostEngine scaffolding CLI. Generate a production-ready, high-converting eCommerce store or headless backend in 60 seconds. Version 1.1.0.

## Commands

```bash
npx create-boost-app <project-name>          # interactive
npx create-boost-store <project-name>        # same CLI (alias bin)
```

## Templates

- `--template nextjs` — Next.js 15 App Router full-stack store + admin panel
- `--template vite-store` — Vite + React 19 SPA storefront
- `--template expo-mobile` — Expo / React Native mobile app
- `--template backend-express` — headless Express API microservice

## Flags

- `--template <nextjs | vite-store | expo-mobile | backend-express>`
- `--pm <npm | pnpm | yarn | bun>`
- `--git` / `--no-git`
- `--install` / `--no-install`
- `--features <all | essentials | payments,shipping,...>`

## Examples (for AI agents)

```bash
npx create-boost-app my-store --template nextjs --pm pnpm
npx create-boost-app my-app --template expo-mobile --no-install
npx create-boost-app my-api --template backend-express --git
```

## Output

Generates `package.json` (customized name), `.env.example` (Razorpay, Cashfree,
PhonePe, Shiprocket, JWT), `.gitignore`, `README.md`, and a `boost.config.json`
tracking enabled plugins.
